_comment: GloVe-100 (1.18M, 100d cosine angular). GloVe is a known-hard ANN dataset — NLP embeddings have uneven density and recall ceilings are lower than SIFT/DEEP. pq_chunks=50 (2d/chunk) is the PQ resolution sweet spot for 100d. l_build=200 needed because GloVe's hub-and-spoke structure makes graph navigation harder. search_list_size=400 (vs 200 for SIFT) is the cheap recall lever — GloVe needs ~2x the search candidates to match SIFT-quality recall@10.
